name: OpenAI API
tagline: Hosted models for chat, embeddings, images, audio, and more
description: OpenAI's REST API for developers to call GPT and other models for chat completions, embeddings, image generation, speech, and related AI tasks. Authenticate with an API key, send HTTPS requests to api.openai.com, and receive JSON responses. Used widely for agents, apps, and automation that need language or multimodal model inference.

auth.details: Bearer token in Authorization header (API key from platform.openai.com); organization/project headers optional

pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go by model and usage (tokens, images, audio); see platform.openai.com/docs/pricing

rate_limits: Tier-based RPM/TPM limits that scale with usage and spend; exact numbers depend on account tier (see rate-limit docs)
use_cases: generate chat completions with a GPT model
create text embeddings for search or clustering
generate or edit images from a prompt
transcribe audio to text with Whisper
build agent tools that call models via the Responses API
